title: Concept: Form submits to an external origin
description: A form whose action points at a host outside the application in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Credentials or payment fields typed into that form travel to the third party, and the page still looks like the bank's own.
applicability: Deployments that render a form whose action points at a host outside the application into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Credentials or payment fields typed into that form travel to the third party, and the page still looks like the bank's own.
